resources.string: Keys usable without user auth; key available on locked device; key migrates via backup; unbounded auth validity window.
StrongBox key + setUserAuthenticationRequired(true) + setUnlockedDeviceRequired(true). Hardware + software defense-in-depth.
Key in StrongBox but no user auth or unlock requirement. Hardware protects key from extraction but not from misuse by any process.
Key created with setUserAuthenticationRequired(true) + setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds(-1). Each use requires fresh biometric.
Keystore key created without setUserAuthenticationRequired(). App unlocked — any process with app UID can use the key.
StrongBox-backed key. Bound to device hardware — cannot be extracted or migrated. Data unrecoverable on different device.
Keystore key without device-binding. Google Backup includes key material — restored on new device, data decryptable without original hardware.
setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds(-1). Each key operation requires a fresh biometric prompt — zero coasting window.
setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds(86400). One biometric scan authorizes all key uses for 24 hours — including by malware.
Key created with setUnlockedDeviceRequired(true). Key becomes unavailable the moment screen locks — no background access possible.
Key has no device-lock restriction. Background service can decrypt sensitive data while device is locked — attack surface during theft.
